_comment: Daily prices for the funds the CFTC markets stand in for, and GLD's
daily gold holdings, for signals/cftc_leadlag.py. All keyless.
Yahoo's chart API returns an adjusted close (dividends and splits folded
in); stooq is the fallback, and its close is already adjusted.
GLD's archive is the trust's own daily record of gold held; a change in
tonnes is shares created or redeemed, i.e. money in or out. SPY, QQQ, USO
and UUP publish only today's shares outstanding, so they have no free
flow history and are tested against price only.
